sources.title: Via Covering: Tented, Untented, Plugged, Epoxy-Filled and Copper-epoxy-filled (page shows 'Last updated on Sep 09, 2026')

facts.quote: Plugged and epoxy-filled vias holes should not be larger than 0.5 mm as larger holes may be incompletely filled.
facts.interpretation: Hole limit, not pad/diameter. Applies to epoxy filling as well as ink plugging.

facts.quote: For holes larger than 0.5mm, plugging is not recommended as it may cause uneven plugging, bubble formation, and potential issues.
facts.interpretation: Hole limit; same note also says 'The via holes of the remaining four should be less than or equal to 0.5mm.'

facts.section: Comparison table, Quality Standard row, Epoxy/Copper-filled & Capped column
facts.quote: Hole surface copper thickness ≥ 5um, leveled solder pads have a 127um depression and protrusion within 50um.
facts.interpretation: Page does not define whether this is the cap (copper plated over the filled hole surface) or the barrel wall. Wording 'hole surface' plus pad-levelness context points to the cap over the filled hole; it is NOT published as a barrel-wall minimum and must not be used as one.

facts.quote: Vias are filled with non-conductive epoxy resin, and then plated over with copper.

facts.section: Comparison table, Notes row, Epoxy/Copper column
facts.quote: For our 6-layer and above multi-layer boards, resin filling is now available for free

facts.section: Comparison table, Ordering row, Epoxy/Copper column
facts.quote: All through-hole solder pads are covered and filled with Epoxy/Copper.
facts.interpretation: Suggests filling applies to all vias on the order, not only via-in-pad (see C2).

facts.quote: Single-sided or double-sided vias, holes in pad, and vias with a distance less than 0.35mm from the pad cannot be plugged with ink. Such vias can be plugged with epoxy or copper.
facts.interpretation: Ink plugging excluded for via-in-pad; distinct process from epoxy fill+cap.

facts.quote: Vias holes should ideally be 0.4 mm or less and no larger than 0.5 mm

facts.section: Soldermask > JLCPCB Via-in-Pad Process / Epoxy Filled & Capped / Copper paste Filled&Capped
facts.quote: Compatible with via diameters from 0.15 to 0.55 mm.
facts.interpretation: Lower bound 0.15 equals the min via HOLE (Drilling row) and is below the min via pad 0.25, and Drilling/HDI buried via uses 'Standard range: 0.15 mm – 0.55 mm (fabricated by mechanical drilling with Epoxy Filled & Capped)'; so most likely a hole/drill range. Inference, not stated.

facts.quote: This process is the default for 6-layer and above multilayer boards.
facts.interpretation: On a 6-layer order all vias are likely filled & capped by default, not only via-in-pad.

facts.quote: Filled vias must be no wider than 0.5 mm diameter
facts.interpretation: Ink-plugging row; 'Vias are filled with soldermask for an opaque finish.'

facts.quote: Multilayer: 0.15 mm hole size / 0.25 mm via diameter
Via diameter should be 0.1mm(0.15mm preferred) larger than Via hole size.
facts.interpretation: E16 0.6-0.3=0.30 mm; satisfied. Not copper-weight qualified. Also 'Preferred Min. Via hole size: 0.2mm'.

facts.process: PTH (row labelled PTH annular ring; listed under 2-layer and Multilayer)
facts.interpretation: No line under the row mentions vias; whether it governs vias is unstated. Multilayer 1 oz: 'Recommended 0.20 mm or above; absolute minimum 0.15 mm'.
Average only; no minimum published anywhere read.

facts.quote: e.g. for the 0.6mm hole size, the finished hole size between 0.52mm to 0.73mm is acceptable.
facts.interpretation: Designed 'hole size' is the finished-hole target; no statement maps drill bit to finished hole.

facts.section: PCB Specifications > Finished Outer/Inner Layer Copper
facts.quote: Multi-layer: 1 oz / 2 oz | 0.5 oz / 1 oz / 2 oz | Finished copper weight of inner layer is 0.5oz by default.
facts.value: 2 oz outer and inner advertised for multilayer
facts.interpretation: No layer-count or thickness restriction stated.

facts.quote: Outer Copper Weight 1oz 2oz inner Copper Weight 0.5oz 1oz 2oz
facts.value: all 17 rows (JLC06161H-*, No requirement): outer 0.035 mm, inner 0.0152 mm
facts.interpretation: No published 6-layer stackup row with 2 oz inner or 2 oz outer.

satisfied: Generic multilayer via min 0.15 mm hole / 0.25 mm diameter (C4): 0.3/0.6 inside
Via diameter >= hole + 0.10 (0.15 preferred) (C5): 0.30 mm margin
Preferred min via hole 0.2 mm: 0.3 inside
Epoxy-fill hole limit <=0.5 mm (G1/G2): 0.3 mm hole inside
Filled&capped range 0.15-0.55 mm (C1) if it is a hole range: 0.3 inside
not_applicable: Soldermask plugging rules (C3, G7): E16 via-in-pad must use epoxy/copper fill; ink plugging is excluded for vias in pad
Tenting limits (G8): separate process; filled-and-capped is the 6-layer default
Copper-paste thermal conductivity: E16 does not rely on fill conductivity
unresolved: Whether the 2 oz PTH annular ring >=0.254 mm (C6) applies to vias; E16 ring 0.15 mm is below it
Whether C1 'via diameters 0.15-0.55' is hole or pad; if pad, 0.6 mm is outside
Meaning of 'Hole surface copper thickness >= 5um' (cap vs wall) and any cap thickness
Guaranteed MINIMUM barrel plating (only 18 um average published)
2 oz on all six layers: advertised, but no published 6-layer 2 oz stackup row; stack dielectric thicknesses unknown
Whether a 6-layer order fills/caps ALL vias by default (C2/G6) rather than only via-in-pad as authored
Drill-bit vs finished-hole mapping for 0.3 mm (only finished-hole tolerance +0.13/-0.08 published)
Overall qualification of this exact stack: a capability listing is not qualification; supplier contact not authorized

reconciliation_0p55_vs_0p5: The guide states a HOLE limit for epoxy-filled vias ('should not be larger than 0.5 mm', advisory). The capability table states 'via diameters from 0.15 to 0.55 mm' without defining the quantity; its 0.15 lower bound matches the min via hole and the HDI buried-via drilled range, so it most plausibly is a hole/drill range, and the 0.05 mm gap may reflect drill vs finished hole or simply differing page conservatism. Not stated by JLCPCB; either way E16's 0.3 mm hole is inside both, and only the pad interpretation (0.6 > 0.55) would fail.
changes_vs_previous_record: Correction: previous record said the 0.5 mm limit 'belongs to soldermask-plugged vias' only. The guide explicitly extends a <=0.5 mm HOLE limit to epoxy-filled vias (G1).
New: guide 'Hole surface copper thickness >= 5um' for epoxy/copper filled & capped (G3); its surface (cap vs wall) is not defined, so no cap or wall minimum is established.
New: filled & capped is the default for 6+ layers and guide ordering says all through-hole pads are filled; E16's 'filled only in via-in-pad' assumption may not match the default process.
Reinforced: C1 0.15-0.55 lower bound equals min via hole, favouring a hole interpretation (inference).
Unchanged: 18 um average plating with no minimum; 2 oz PTH ring 0.254 mm with no via wording; no 2 oz 6-layer stackup row (all inner 0.0152 mm).
fetch_failures: No dedicated JLCPCB via-in-pad/POFV page is linked from the guide; the capabilities 'JLCPCB Via-in-Pad Process' row was used instead. The term 'POFV' does not appear on either page.
Cap thickness and barrel-wall minimum: not published on any page read.
